title: The content coverage step on the Road to live reads the coverage file and blocks Publish on undeclared demo content
steps: S1: Run the content coverage tests of tracy-web (apps/tracy-web/test/content-coverage.test.mjs and road-to-live.test.mjs).
expect: S1: every test passes: the step is green for a coverage file with no unaccepted hole and red, carrying the fix loop, for one with an unaccepted hole or page hygiene finding.
fence: Unit-level check of the judge that turns a coverage file into the Road to live step
